typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 9 / takeaway.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 9 / credit.

recognitionRules: Use Charter for explanatory reading and Helvetica for navigation.
Give each scientific plate a number, source and useful caption.
Use restrained green only to guide attention within an otherwise neutral field.
Ask for an explanation before revealing the model.
Keep image provenance and illustrative model limits visible.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: What you see depends on where you look from. Let us test the model.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use LIGHT AND VIEWPOINT in Helvetica with two offset open circles connected by a thin line. This is a new diagrammatic mark, not an astronomical institution’s logo.
invariants: Use Charter for explanatory reading and Helvetica for navigation.
Give each scientific plate a number, source and useful caption.
Use restrained green only to guide attention within an otherwise neutral field.
adaptations: A handout retains image credits and the learner’s explanation prompt.
Simplify diagrams before reducing caption size.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Charter is a system or separately licensed font; not bundled.
Helvetica is a separately licensed/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
